title: arctostaphylos mewukka subsp. truei
intro: Arctostaphylos mewukka subsp. truei, commonly known as Bigberry manzanita, is a shrub species in the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine, offering potential health benefits such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Bigberry manzanita are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may have anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular-protective effects. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Bigberry manzanita for medicinal purposes.
